newsitem.title: USA: Media General sees newsprint prices rising.
newsitem.headline: Media General sees newsprint prices rising.

text.p: Media General Inc, reporting slightly higher net income for its fourth quarter, said it expects the first half of 1997 to be aided by rising newsprint prices.

"We expect newsprint prices will strengthen in the first half of the year, and the outlook for our publishing, broadcast and cable television operations in 1997 remains quite positive," said Media General Chairman J. Stewart Bryan.
Media General reported fourth-quarter 1996 net income on Thursday of $18.9 million, or $0.71 per share, on revenues of $200 million.
The 1995 fourth-quarter booked net income of $18.5 million, or $0.70 per share, on revenues of $201 million.
